# Art by John Philip Morgan

> A personal catalog for discovering and saving physical art, artists, galleries, and styles curated by John Philip Morgan.

Canonical site: https://art.jpamorgan.com/
Creator: John Philip Morgan (https://jpamorgan.com)

## When to use Art

Use Art when someone wants to discover, browse, compare, or discuss curated physical artworks. It is a good fit for:

- exploring the public catalog across artists, galleries, styles, and categories;
- finding recent works or sorting works by title or artist;
- comparing returned artwork metadata and suggesting works that match a stated interest; and
- opening a canonical artwork page for details and source attribution.

Do not treat the catalog as an authority on market prices, authenticity, provenance, or financial advice. The creator is the individual John Philip Morgan; `jpamorgan` here does not identify JPMorgan Chase.

## How agents should use Art

For direct browsing, start at https://art.jpamorgan.com/. Public pages render meaningful HTML without client-side JavaScript. Browse the full indexes at:

- https://art.jpamorgan.com/artists
- https://art.jpamorgan.com/galleries
- https://art.jpamorgan.com/styles

For structured access, connect an MCP client to https://api.art.jpamorgan.com/mcp and call the read-only `browse_art` tool. It accepts an optional `limit` from 1 to 12, `sort` (`recent`, `title`, or `artist`), and `category`, `style`, `gallery`, or `artist` filters. The result contains concise artwork cards with canonical https://art.jpamorgan.com/art/ URLs and may include an interactive MCP Apps view.

Prefer the MCP tool when selecting or comparing catalog entries. Use the public website when a person needs to inspect an artwork page or interact with personal saved and recommendation feeds.
